whatsNew.en-AU: TaskNotes now works with the upgraded mdbase service. When your account is upgraded, approve TaskNotes once to continue; your collections and notes are unchanged. If your account is still being upgraded, TaskNotes will ask you to wait and retry. Your tasks are safe. This update also improves repeating tasks, offline saving, and error messages.

TaskNotes 1.0.9 update

REVIEW ACCESS
The embedded demo has been removed. A review account with a sample collection is provided in the App Review sign-in information. Sign in with it from the opening screen.

CHANGES IN THIS UPDATE
mdbase is moving accounts to an upgraded encrypted sync service in stages. This version uses only the upgraded service. Accounts still being upgraded see a waiting screen with retry; they do not use the old backend. After an upgrade the user approves TaskNotes once in the mdbase sign-in window. There are no new permissions. The update also improves repeating-task dates, offline saving and plain-language error messages.

FUNCTIONS AND AUDIENCE
TaskNotes is a task manager for people who want portable structured Markdown records. Users can capture, edit, complete, search, assign and reorder tasks; set dates, priorities, recurrence, reminders and time estimates; use lists, boards and calendars; attach images; and turn Scratchpad notes into tasks.

OPTIONAL SERVICES
mdbase provides access to an authorized persistent collection and reminder timers. Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification service deliver content-free reminder notifications after explicit opt-in.
